title: Juniper and the Extraction
author: Odile Crane
blurb: Edmund Joubert, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
